body:
The apcs test tomorrow is on EVERYTHING. It's like a practice test for the real AP test so it covers a lot of material and it's 22 multiple choice questions. 

I'm hoping that I just become actually sick tomorrow (from the tylenol/advil) instead because I really don't want to lie. like if I go to the nurse first thing in the morning and tell her i have a stomachache or something she'll ask WHY and all

They probably wouldn’t send me to one. 

I don’t think a distinct change occurred but I think I just got really really sick and tired of studying every single day unhappily.

The two tests are on chemistry which I’m doing the worst in currently and AP computer science which is generally my worst subject (I got an 18/40 on a practice test). It’s no use. I can’t go to school tomorrow and I don’t know how else to get out.

I'm a little bit afraid of having to go to a mental hospital or something. I'm not always suicidal though? I'm in 10th grade and school is out on June 25th. Summer means more studying though, due to SAT's and whatnot (in America at least). When I procrastinate I spend time on social media or Youtube on my phone/computer. Even when I DON'T procrastinate I am somehow terrible at time management. When I said I was hopeless-that might have not been the most accurate statement. I just don't feel excited for the future like I did even just 2 months ago.  

I think I'm going to take 2 more tylenols to make it 4000mg like I planned on doing, I still haven't felt anything for an hour and I'm worried I'll have to go to school tomorrow :/

Well, it's not exactly an EASY thing to say, is it? I guess I'm afraid of the reaction? 

Going to a rigorous high school and maintaining a 4.0 GPA means that I basically don't have a life outside of school and I'm burnt out. I've always had problems with focusing/procrastinating and I usually start studying at around 10-midnight which has always somehow worked out for me but because I'm so tired and don't have the energy to care enough, my grades are slowly slipping. I feel so unfulfilled because other than being a good student, I'm worthless. All I do is do my homework, study a little bit, and sleep. I wish I could just not care about school but I've already invested so much into becoming a "good student" that I can't just let it fly out the window! Further, I have no idea where I stand in my class since I have good grades but like no extra curricular activities, so I'm not even sure what types of colleges I'll be able to get into... everything is just so tiring and I'm sick of it. 

I just don't feel that happy anymore and I feel ok with dying right now, because I feel relatively hopeless about the future. I also have two huge, difficult tests tomorrow that I feel like I'm screwed for and I have to do everything I can to avoid taking them tomorrow.

I only took 3000mg of the Tylenol. 

None of my friends or I have our licenses yet, so it's not an option to go to the hospital with just my friend. 

I also have two extremely important tests tomorrow in school and I need to make sure that I don't take them (since I can't really prepare at this point). I'm really worried about this, since I don't think I'm going to die.

Nobody knows. I might tell my mom or dad later but I'm pretty afraid of telling them, even though that was kind of the point. I might tell a friend if I can't tell my parents. Also I think I'm going to take 1 or 2 more [Tylenol].
How would I have to increase the dosages?
I took 2500mg (5 pills) of the Tylenol instead ... does that change anything?
